#========================================
# How to compile the Linux kernel/rtk_driver/common
#========================================

#----------------------------------------
@@. Elements in the package
#----------------------------------------
+ kernel-1.0.0-711.kalaupapa.4.tar.gz
- README_HowToMake.txt : describe how to compile source codes using toolchain

#----------------------------------------
@@. The order to compile codes
#----------------------------------------
1)./starfish-sdk-x86_64-ca9v1-toolchain-5.0.0-20190307.sh
- Enter target directory for SDK (default: /opt/starfish-sdk-x86_64/5.0.0-20190307): /HOME/USERNAME/TOOLCHAIN
- You are about to install the SDK to "DIRECTORY". Proceed[Y/n]? y
- You need remember you toolchain install path.
2) export toolchain PATH:
- PATH=/HOME/USERNAME/TOOLCHAIN/sysroots/x86_64-starfishsdk-linux/usr/bin/arm-starfish-linux:$PATH
3) make config and make
- make realtek/config.develop.rtd2875.tv006.emmc.old_defconfig
- CROSS_COMPILE=arm-starfish-linux- make KALLSYMS_EXTRA_PASS=1

#----------------------------------------
@@. Output path and file
#----------------------------------------
- .:
-- vmlinux.bin : linux binary file

INTRODUCTION
===============================================================================
Source code path:
download source with below path:					
checkout wall.lge.com/bsp/realtek/boot to 
	boot/


HOW TO SET TOOLCHAIN
===============================================================================
For 64bit toolchain
1. Get toolchain file
2. Run toolchain script and remember your install SDK path.
	$ ./starfish-sdk-x86_64-ca9v1-toolchain-5.0.0-20190307.sh
	webOS TV SDK installer version 5.0.0-20190307
	=============================================
	Enter target directory for SDK (default: /opt/starfish-sdk-x86_64/5.0.0-20190307): .
	You are about to install the SDK to "/opt/starfish-sdk-x86_64/5.0.0-20190307". Proceed[Y/n]? Y
	Extracting SDK..........................done
	Setting it up...done
	SDK has been successfully set up and is ready to be used.
	
	
HOW TO BUILD
===============================================================================
For 64bit toolchain
1. Setup toolchain path
	export LG_TOOLCHAIN_PATH=/opt/starfish-sdk-x86_64/5.0.0-20190307
2. Build Boot
	- make -C bin PRJ=B3_A1R41 
	or
	- make -C bin PRJ=B7_A1R62
